item.title: Jeremy Fears Jr. leads No. 15 Michigan State to 82-59 win over UCLA
item.description: Jeremy Fears Jr. had 16 points and 10 assists, leading No. 15 Michigan State to an 82-59 victory over UCLA.

item.title: Indonesia tightens control on nickel as the US and China scramble for critical minerals
item.description: Indonesia is tightening state control over its globally important nickel industry after years of betting that the metal would anchor a homegrown electric-vehicle industry.

item.title: Ohio State upends No. 24 Wisconsin 86-69
item.description: Bruce Thornton scored 27 points and Devin Royal added 25 for Ohio State as the Buckeyes knocked off No. 24 Wisconsin 86-69.

item.title: NC State was wounded. The Wolfpack found the perfect salve in rolling past injury-hit rival UNC
Bennett Stirtz scores 25 points as Iowa downs No. 9 Nebraska, 57-52
item.description: Bennett Stirtz scored 25 points and Cooper Koch added 10 as Iowa overcame a cold-shooting second half to defeat No. 9 Nebraska 57-52.

item.title: Haggerty, Johnson combine for 67, lead K-State over Baylor 90-74 in coach Matthew Driscoll's debut
item.description: Kansas State cruises past Baylor 90-74 as interim coach Matthew Driscoll wins his debut and the Wildcats snap a long skid.

item.title: Georgia beats Kentucky 86-78 for the program's 1st first win at Rupp Arena since 2009
item.description: Blue Cain scored 20 points, Jeremiah Wilkinson added 19 points off the bench and Georgia beat Kentucky 86-78 on Tuesday night for its first win at Rupp Arena since 2009.

item.title: Surprise shark caught on camera for first time in Antarctica's near-freezing deep
item.description: A marine researcher says he has video evidence of the first recorded shark in the Antarctic Ocean.

item.title: Swain, Vokietaitas double dip to help Texas past LSU 88-85
item.description: Dailyn Swain scored 21 points and grabbed 10 rebounds and Matas Vokietaitas recorded a double-double and Texas held off gutty LSU for an 88-85 win.

item.title: Asian shares gain as most regional markets stay closed for Lunar New Year holidays
item.description: Shares in Asia are higher, with Japan's benchmark gaining more than 1% after a quiet finish for U.S. stocks.
